subject: [PATCH 2/2] nfsd: Honor delegated timestamps when change and size match

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 server where delegated timestamps are not honored when the change and size attributes match. The problem occurs because the holder of a timestamp delegation is not considered authoritative for atime and mtime, even if they have a valid delegation. The patch changes the behavior to always apply the CB_GETATTR times for timestamp delegations, and updates the file's modification time accordingly. This ensures that clients see the correct timestamps after a write operation, even if the change and size attributes match.
